frequency_question: What proportion of major federal agency regulatory actions complete the full notice-and-comment and finalization lifecycle within a standard 338-day window from initial proposal publication?
membership_rule: Includes all economically significant rules published as Notices of Proposed Rulemaking (NPRMs) by executive departments that subsequently progressed to a Final Rule; excludes rules withdrawn prior to proposal or interim final rules bypassing initial steps.
provenance_note: 5 cases named, 15 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (3.0x)
coverage_note: 5 named illustrative cases from a broader estimated population of 15 comparable high-complexity economic rulemakings.
known_gaps: Excludes minor technical corrections and non-economically significant agency actions.
skeleton: Total major rules proposed divided by those completing the full NPRM-to-Final Rule cycle within 12 months, using agency historical duration metrics.
multiplier: 5 instances analyzed / 15 attempted major complex rules within timeframe = 0.33
validity_reason: Administrative Procedure Act timelines and OIRA review procedures remain stable across this timeframe.
